notes.title: Development Update: August 18th 2021
notes.notes:
Development Updates and Values

There has been a lot of radio silence recently here on the development front which is something I want to clear up, especially since the last update was the conjuror beta which still hasn't moved to the main branch.

To be fully transparent I have been busy. Many aspects of life have been a bit of a jumble in the recent months. Between the changing restrictions from covid-19 meaning I am no longer (stuck) in my house, while also giving me more ways to connect to those I haven't seen, I've opted to devote time to aspects of my life I wasn't able to during the development of Strife: The Expanse and the covid-19 pandemic.

Furthermore my friends have also had similar changes to their lifestyle, meaning that I have had less time and opportunity to test changes and updates to the level of bug-free that I'd be comfortable selling. 

Because I believe in transparency, even if this is a $2 game I want you to have all the facts.


 I am still making content for Strife: The Expanse.
 There is no guarantee this content, if ever, could release. I could suffer a freak accident, other life events could occur. I'm one poor grad student doing this as a side hobby. If you've purchased this game (or decide to) do so on the content available.
 Any content I add to the game I plan on making free. I feel this is a fair tradeoff to the above uncertainty.


Conjuror Progress
Conjuror playtesting went well. No bugs or crashes occurred in playtesting so I am moving forward and adding achievements as well as doing a few more small changes, and cleanup such as editing the manual included with the game. 

As previously mentioned the Conjuror is available in the Steam Beta branch. Try it out if you haven't!

Closing

I hope you all enjoy Strife: The Expanse. I hope to continue being able to add additions to the game for everyone to try.

notes.title: Conjuror Beta Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you are excited for new Strife: The Expanse content! Today marks the beta release for the Conjuror! Swap to the beta branch and try it out!

This post will serve as a small patch post as the character isn't totally finished and still requires testing.

Conjuror
This unit boasts good ranged damage on the basic attack, as well as the ability to buff allied teammates by increasing their attack stat by 3 and lowering their defence by 5. The numbers are still being tested and tweaked so I don't get too attached as this may change as it moves to the stable branch.

Health: 95
Attack: 24
Range: 7
Defence: 26
Movement: 5

Other Patch Notes
-The Archer special attack has been substantially improved and looks insane right now! I highly encourage you to check it out!

-A second page for more units has been added.

-Fixed issue with unit placing UI showing the name of the unit's c# class instead of the unit's actual name. (Ex Flame Wyvern would say Dragon).

To Do:
Achievements still need to be added for the conjuror.

Balance and playtesting still needs to occur.

Closing
Please keep and eye out for more development news and let me know of any issues you experience if you choose to play with the conjuror while she's still in beta! More units will be coming with time (all for free!)

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards & Beta Branch Update
notes.notes:
The beta branch for Strife: The Expanse was released today. This will allow me (and you) to test various features and swap them over to live very easily once they are ready. In this case it is the Steam Leaderboard feature which is now up and ready to go!

How to Join
To enter into the beta branch simply go to the game in your library, right click and select properties. Go to the betas tab and change the drop down to "beta - Beta Testing". Due to how I've set up the backend with Steam's API if you choose not to opt in, your scores will be updated whenever the changes go live on the main branch. The beta currently is compatible with the default branch so you can still play with your friends. This may change however in the future.

Steam Leaderboards
If you navigate to the achievements list you'll be able to access leaderboards and compare yourself versus your friends. The leaderboards currently are for all stats you see in the stats tab on your main menu. If you want to compare yourself against the world just visit the global achievements section and select global leaderboards at the top! I've obviously omitted myself from these leaderboards so it'll be as fair as possible!

Once I feel confident that the changes I've made to the game are not going to cause any issues, I'll move the beta branch over to the main one.

Other Beta Changes
-Optimized the stats menu. Previously it updated every time you opened it. Now it only does so when loading the main menu.
-Fixed a niche bug where if you tried to join someone who was kicked from a match by their host disconnecting in the lobby, that you would be unable to play single-player or host a game until you tried a second time. Let me know if this fix causes any issues.

Happy Playing!

notes.title: Release Date Set & Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What a journey it has been! Strife: The Expanse is ready for release and will be coming to your very shortly. Barring and large scale bugs found between now and release, the game will be out May 14th 2021.

Going Forward

So what does this mean going forward? Well it means that once the game is out it'll be ready for criticism and praise alike. Furthermore depending on reception I would like to be able to add more units to the game. Whether that is financially viable or not depends on feedback.

Beta -> Release Patch Notes

Technical: 

-Removed the ability to change render scale in VR. Higher render scales would dramatically increase CPU overhead causing crashes with oculus spacewarp.

-Fixed issues with the fixed HUD setting in VR not toggling properly.

-Made Static VR HUD Option the default. You can enable tracking in the settings. Note if you have played before this that you setting will be the opposite of whatever you previously had checked.

Closing

Overall I am very excited to share this news with you. I truly hope the game lives up to your expectations.

notes.title: Beta Test Patch Notes 2020-04-06 & Steam Page Launch
notes.notes:
It has been very exciting launching the steam page today! Alongside it I am releasing this patch with few improvements to the game. Additionally features such as these patch notes are now accessible to me so this is also a test of their feature set to better help serve you information in the future.

Below is the following rough changelog from the last update to the current version:

Gameplay:

 Changed how AI use unit special attacks on the backend to improve workflow.
 Both the dragon and Archer now use their special attacks when controlled by AI players. All units now have special abilities useable by AI.
 Fixed an issue where the select Unit UI would not function correctly in VR. 
 Players now look at their spawn zone when their turn begins during unit placing.
 Players now return to their spawn location after unit placing is over.
 Bushes now correctly block line of sight.


Cosmetic:

Water VR fixes.
Potential Fix for Flickering Main Menu
 When Shamans use a special attack it will then look at the enemy unit at the end of the attack.
 Sound of the Archers bow audio has been dramatically increased.
 Players in VR now have white blocks for hands rather than nothing.


Steam:
Added 3 more achievements bringing the total to 52!
These achievements require you to  heal 250, 500 and 750 points of healing in a single game from your units. Try it out!

Other
If you have been testing the game so far, please take a look at the new trailer and provide your feedback!
